# z88 Technologies

> z88 Technologies turns a person's resume, social links and photos into a fully hosted personal portfolio website. AI writes the copy and designs the site, and it is published at the person's own subdomain, yourname.z88.tech, over HTTPS.

## What it does

- Input: a handle and a name (required); optionally a resume (PDF, DOCX or TXT), up to 10 images, a bio, a tagline and social profile links.
- Output: a live personal portfolio site at https://yourname.z88.tech, usually ready in 2 to 5 minutes.
- No coding, design work or separate hosting is needed.

## Key pages

- [Home and site generator](https://z88.tech/): describes the service and hosts the generation form.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://z88.tech/#faq)
